Diagnosis: Appendicitis
Evidence: The patient presents with right iliac fossa pain, nausea, diarrhea, and fever, which are classic symptoms of appendicitis. The elevated white blood cell count and C-reactive protein level also support this diagnosis. The abdominal CT scan showing a swollen and thickened tubular structure at the cecal pole with a pericecal collection is consistent with appendicitis.
